title: An underline that grows
summary: A ::after bar scaled from 0 to 1 with transform-origin decides which side the underline grows from.
explanation: Each link has a ::after bar positioned along its bottom edge. At rest it is transform: scaleX(0), so it has no width on screen; on hover it scales to 1. Animating transform is smooth because the browser does not have to redo the layout, unlike animating width.
transform-origin says where the scale starts. left grows it from the left, center from the middle, right from the right. The three links differ only in that one line.
:focus-visible is in the same selector as :hover, so keyboard users get the same underline.
tryThis: Change the first link's transform-origin to right: it grows the other way.
Replace scaleX(0) with scaleX(0.2): a short bar shows at rest and grows on hover.
